recordText: From the 1560s, meaning "pertaining to marriage," from Latin *genialis*, festive, originally of wedding rites. It meant "cheerful, friendly" by 1746.
gossipText: Started out as the wedding planner. Now she's just pleasant. Still keeps a list of who married whom.
testimony: Lovely boy, very wholesome. Wheat germ, you know. But his Latin is of uncertain origin. I've married off half this family, and I couldn't tell you who his parents are.
